::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
₹500cr Ultra High Purity (UHP) gas hub aimed at closing a real gap: INOX currently makes ~12 of the ~30-45 specialty gases the industry needs domestically, with the rest imported. This expands domestic UHP gas coverage rather than just adding bulk-gas capacity.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

UHP bulk and specialty gases — nitrogen, oxygen, argon, hydrogen — for fabs and OSAT units.

## Project Timeline

- **06 Oct 2025** — INOX Air Products begins building ₹500cr specialty gas hub in Dholera; land secured earlier in 2025
